premise: Redesign a modern virtual-card landing page using intaglio-inspired art direction. Gradients are the hook; the transformation is the story.

beats.title: The hook
beats.purpose: Introduce the question of art direction.
beats.script: Your UI doesn’t need another gradient. It needs art direction.
beats.visual: A modern finance landing page. The actual design is still to be explored.
beats.notes: Working title and hook; delivery is not locked.

beats.title: The starting point
beats.purpose: Give viewers a clear before state.
beats.script: Introduce a virtual-card service inspired by the premise of Privacy.com.
beats.visual: A placeholder for the existing modern landing page.
beats.notes: Choose a coherent starting design without building the complete site.

beats.title: A different visual language
beats.purpose: Connect the proposed art direction to this product.
beats.script: Introduce intaglio as a possible direction for money, privacy, and control.
beats.visual: A placeholder for an intaglio reference.
beats.notes: Explore the direction before making claims about the outcome.

beats.title: The transformation
beats.purpose: Carry the viewer from the original design to a different direction.
beats.visual: Redesign exploration — one placeholder beat for now.
beats.notes: Which decisions matter to the story? Leave the detailed walkthrough open.

beats.title: The comparison
beats.purpose: Let the viewer judge the change.
beats.visual: Before and after, using the same product premise.
beats.notes: Does the redesign have a more distinctive, coherent identity? The result is not decided.

beats.title: The takeaway
beats.purpose: Bring the demonstration back to the opening idea.
beats.script: A deliberate visual language can change how a product feels.
beats.notes: Revisit this conclusion after exploring the design.
